messages:
Sam (Sales): Quick thread — Aureus POC is ready to convert to a Dedicated commit. They want a 6-month reserved pool with mixed GPUs (4xA100 + 2xH100), plus predictable burst for peak testing windows. I need deal-desk approval for a special credit structure and a temporary higher burst cap. Deal id: D-4821.

Ada (Solutions): Thanks. From the POC telemetry, they average ~120 concurrent tokens/sec, spike to ~380 for short jobs. My rec: a mixed pool with autoscale min=3 nodes, target=6, max=10. Burst windows are 2x baseline for up to 6 hours/day for first 30 days.

Ada (Solutions): Example pool config we tested:
```
pool: aureus-mixed-prod
min: 3
target: 6
max: 10
gpus: [a100-80gb:4, h100-80gb:2]
autoscale_policy: conservative-burst-2x
burst_window: daily, 00:00-06:00 UTC
```

Mike (Finance): Quick math: if reserved rate = $12/GPU-hour for A100 and $18/GPU-hour for H100, and burst multiplier = 1.8x, effective blended rate depends on usage mix. Need to cap the front-loaded credits we offer — recommend 10% prepaid credit applied across first 3 invoices rather than a blanket upfront discount.

Mike (Finance): If Sales wants to offer a larger credit (>=20%), it needs VP approval and a finance worksheet. Also confirm whether commit is billed monthly or invoiced net-30 upfront — affects revenue recognition.

Lisa (EngOps): Two ops notes: 1) We can't guarantee burst above max nodes if cluster already at capacity in region — need failover policy (route to compatible region or fallback model). 2) We should ship a runbook for their SREs with autoscale knobs and an escape hatch to throttle test jobs. I've opened ticket RED-3221 to track runbook + capacity anchor config: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/RED-3221

Jorge (Legal): For the special credit and burst carve-out we need an amendment to the SOW: explicitly state burst is best-effort with a defined fallback, and list data residency/KMS terms for Private control plane. Also confirm discount approval authority — discounts >=15% must go to Legal+Finance signoff per policy.

Sam (Sales): Got it. Proposed commercial ask: 6-month commit, monthly billing, 10% prepaid credit applied across invoices 1-3, burst multiplier 1.6x for certified hours limited to first 30 days, fallback to a smaller model variant if unavailable. Can Finance + Legal sign off or propose edits?

Mike (Finance): I can accept 10% credit + 1.6x burst multiplier. Need to see a short Excel: committed GPU-hours by month, expected burst hours, and resulting ARR impact. I will prepare the worksheet once Sam uploads the forecast numbers.

Jorge (Legal): I can draft the SOW amendment language. Addendum must include "best-effort burst", "fallback routing", and credit recoup if customer terminates early within commit term. I'll try to get a draft by EOD Tuesday.

Ada (Solutions): FYI we'll need to lock the model variants and quantization profile for fallback to avoid quality regressions when routed. I'll attach the evals summary to the deal folder (uploaded to drive).

Sam (Sales): Next steps checklist: 1) I upload forecast (committed GPU-hours/month) — I'll do that now. 2) Mike prepares finance worksheet. 3) Jorge drafts SOW addendum. 4) Lisa + EngOps finalize runbook and RED-3221. 5) Deal desk form submission after internal signoffs. Tagging D-4821. :spiral_calendar: :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Billing note: Special credits must be entered as a negative line item on invoice and referenced to internal discount code SALESPROC-D4821. Finance to confirm code before first invoice generation.

Sam (Sales): Thanks team — looping in ADELA (customer success) in separate thread for onboarding timeline. If Finance or Legal need anything from me I can jump on a 15m sync today.
